# Energy Stock Alliance (ESA)

> Energy Stock Alliance is a renewable-energy consulting company based in Andorra la Vella (Andorra), founded in 2021 by Gaetan Capou. ESA works on the energy transition with a focus on **energy storage systems**, through two missions: the **RENEW SCORE** battery rating system (an independent, non-governmental rating of storage products — "Yuka for batteries") and **energy storage sourcing** for European businesses (selection, group purchasing, quality control, logistics, with teams in Europe and Asia).

## Company
- **Name:** Energy Stock Alliance (ESA)
- **Founded:** 2021 (15+ years of prior PV/LED engineering & OEM experience since 2008)
- **CEO:** Gaetan Capou
- **Address:** C/ Prat de la Creu, 8, local 5, AD500 Andorra la Vella, Andorra
- **Phone:** +376 812 696
- **Email:** contact@energy-stock.com
- **Sister company:** HCEA Consulting (same CEO) — hcea.asia
- **Motto:** "Look to the sky to produce your energy, look to the earth to store your energy." (2015)

## Key facts
- RENEW SCORE: rating system so customers and businesses can get an overview of each battery/storage product **before** purchasing — performance, lifecycle, sustainability impact.
- Sourcing: ESA mitigates lead-time and price risk for storage components (batteries, inverters, connectors, mounting). Track record includes OEM in China for European brands, group purchasing, on-site quality control, and peak-time air freight (3 tonnes/week for a partner).
- Related brand: LUXCOMB (solar, building-integrated PV certified in 2008). An investment fund for new technologies has been set up.
- Values: commitment, responsibility, respect for the next generations, respect for the planet, a better society, integrity, objective (non-governmental) assessment.
